description: Corporate and trade-association PACs linked to a public company (by ticker) or found by committee name, with the candidates they fund. Answers "does Lockheed have a PAC and who does it give to", "which politicians take money from Pfizer's PAC". For super PACs and mega-donors use super_pacs and money_trail instead.
name: pac_lookup
title: A company's PAC and who it funds
